findings.title: getForLogin ignores organization invalidations
findings.body: In InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.getForLogin only isInvalid(cacheKeyForLogin) is checked. In contrast getByOrganization checks isInvalid(cacheKeyOrgId) || isInvalid(orgId). Organization updates, removals, enable/disable, and link/unlink of IDPs via OrganizationProvider invalidate the orgId, not the login key. As a result a cached login list keyed by FetchMode continues to be served stale after org changes, returning IDPs that should have appeared/disappeared.

findings.title: Login predicate NPE when IDP config is null
findings.body: LoginFilter.getLoginPredicate now does idp.getConfig().get(OrganizationModel.BROKER_PUBLIC). If an IdentityProviderModel has a null config map, calling getForLogin invalidation via registerIDPLoginInvalidation/registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate throws NullPointerException. This breaks create/update/remove of such IDPs. The predicate must be null-safe for both the model and the config map.

findings.title: remove/update NPE when IDP does not exist
findings.body: In InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.remove the code fetches storedIdp via idpDelegate.getByAlias and unconditionally passes it to registerIDPInvalidation which dereferences idp.getInternalId(). If the alias does not exist storedIdp is null, so remove of a non-existent alias throws NPE instead of returning false. The same pattern exists in update where getById can return null and is passed to registerIDPInvalidation.

findings.title: REALM_ONLY login path missing enabled re-check
findings.body: The patch adds filter idp.isEnabled() to the ORG_ONLY and ALL paths from getForLogin with comment that cached IDPs might be wrapped and stale, but leaves the REALM_ONLY path filtering only on alias. A stale cached list can therefore still expose a disabled realm IDP on the login page, inconsistent with the other modes.
